offering_description.value: The Ensign Group provides skilled nursing, post-acute rehabilitation, and senior living services to patients and older adults. Local subsidiaries operate care facilities and provide ancillary services such as mobile diagnostics and medical transportation. Its real estate business also leases healthcare facilities to other operators.

primary_services.value: Skilled nursing and long-term care; post-acute rehabilitation; assisted living and other senior living services; mobile diagnostics and medical transportation; healthcare facility leasing

customer_segment.value: B2C: Patients recovering after hospitalization, long-term nursing residents, and older adults seeking senior living; B2B: Healthcare providers using ancillary services and third-party operators leasing care facilities

end_markets.value: Skilled nursing and long-term care; post-acute rehabilitation; senior living; healthcare real estate

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicare, Medicaid, and private insurers pay for covered nursing, rehabilitation, and related care; service fees: Private-pay residents pay for care and senior living, and healthcare customers pay for ancillary services; rental or leasing: Third-party care operators pay rent for healthcare facilities
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses clinical staff and equipment to deliver care to patients and ancillary services to healthcare providers; asset operator: Owns healthcare properties used by its care subsidiaries or leased to third-party operators

geography_served.value: US regional: Multiple states across the Western, Midwestern, and Southern United States, including California, Arizona, and Texas

specialization.value: related lines: Skilled nursing, rehabilitation, senior living, ancillary clinical services, and healthcare facility leasing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Skilled nursing and senior living facilities operated by local subsidiaries; other: Hospital discharge planners and other healthcare providers referring patients to care facilities; direct sales: Property leases negotiated directly with third-party healthcare operators

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State licensing for nursing and assisted living facilities, plus CMS certification and participation requirements for skilled nursing facilities

notes: The exact current state footprint and full mix of ancillary services are uncertain.
